decks.notes: The main concept of this deck is to use the combo between Greasefang, Okiba Boss and Parhelion II to create a powerful board presence and overwhelm the opponent. The deck also focuses on disruption and control, utilizing cards like Duress, Thoughtseize, and Liliana of the Veil to disrupt the opponent's strategy. Additionally, the deck includes cards for card advantage, such as Grisly Salvage and Raffine's Informant, and has a selection of powerful lands to ensure consistent mana production. Overall, the deck aims to execute its combo while controlling the opponent's options and maintaining card advantage.

The deck focuses on utilizing Lotus Field for mana advantage and combining it with cards like Hidden Strings, Thespian's Stage, and Vizier of Tumbling Sands to generate a powerful combo. It also includes various cards for card draw and searching. The aim is to set up a board state where you can cast powerful spells like Omniscience and Emergent Ultimatum to overwhelm your opponent with a strong finish. The deck also includes some control elements and flexibility with cards like Fae of Wishes and Bala Ged Recovery for additional options in different situations.

This deck focuses on ramping up mana quickly through green devotion cards and mana dorks such as Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic. It then aims to play big threats like Cavalier of Thorns, Old-Growth Troll, and Polukranos Reborn to overwhelm the opponent. Karn, the Great Creator can provide additional utility, while Storm the Festival helps dig for key creatures. The deck also includes some protection with Wolfwillow Haven and Lair of the Hydra. Overall, the key idea is to quickly amass mana and play big threats to outpace the opponent.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and utilizing powerful enchantments and artifacts to control the board and deal direct damage. The deck includes a companion card for added synergy and consistency. With a mix of efficient creatures, removal spells, and land cards that help generate extra mana, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents quickly and close out the game before they have a chance to stabilize. Additionally, the inclusion of versatile lands and a diverse range of card types provides flexibility and adaptability in various matchups.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using green mana dorks and Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx, while also maintaining a high devotion to green for powerful effects. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with large green creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll, while also utilizing Kiora, Behemoth Beckoner and Storm the Festival for card advantage and additional threats. The inclusion of Karn, the Great Creator offers versatility and disruption against opposing strategies. Overall, this deck excels at aggressive plays and big mana generation in order to dominate the battlefield.

This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on fast, aggressive gameplay with a mix of removal spells and powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant, Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Thoughtseize and Duress to disrupt the opponent's game plan. The deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with early threats and disruption, while using powerful late-game cards like Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Bloodtithe Harvester to seal the deal. Overall, the deck is designed to put pressure on the opponent and maintain a strong board presence throughout the game.

The key concept of this deck is to aggressively attack the opponent with a combination of powerful creatures like Bonecrusher Giant, Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger, and Bloodtithe Harvester, while disrupting their game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push. The deck also utilizes disruptive planeswalkers like Liliana of the Veil and strong late-game threats like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. It aims to pressure the opponent early and take control of the game with a mix of aggression and disruption, ultimately overwhelming the opponent to secure a victory.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays with a combination of efficient removal spells and powerful creatures in the Rakdos color combination. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with hand disruption like Thoughtseize and Duress while quickly applying pressure on the board with cards like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester. The deck also utilizes strong finishers like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse and Fable of the Mirror-Breaker to close out games swiftly. Additionally, the inclusion of cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Liliana of the Veil provide additional disruption and card advantage to stay ahead in the game.

The key concept of this deck is to control the game through counter spells, removal, and card advantage. The deck aims to disrupt the opponent's strategy by countering their spells with cards like Censor, Negate, and Sinister Sabotage. It also utilizes removal spells such as Fatal Push and Extinction Event to deal with the opponent's threats. The deck gains card advantage through cards like Dig Through Time, Search for Azcanta, and Memory Deluge. It aims to establish a strong board presence with cards like Shark Typhoon and Hullbreaker Horror while maintaining control over the game.

This deck focuses on fast and aggressive gameplay with a Rakdos color combination. It aims to disrupt the opponent's hand with Thoughtseize and removal spells like Fatal Push and Dreadbore. Creatures like Bonecrusher Giant and Bloodtithe Harvester help deal damage quickly, while cards like Kroxa, Titan of Death's Hunger and Sheoldred, the Apocalypse provide additional pressure and value. The mana base is designed to support a fast and consistent curve, with various utility lands like Castle Locthwain and Hive of the Eye Tyrant. Overall, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with its efficient threats and disruption.

This Gruul Aggro deck focuses on dealing direct damage to the opponent while utilizing aggressive creatures to overwhelm them quickly. The deck includes burn spells like Stoke the Flames and Play with Fire, as well as creature enhancements like Atarka's Command and Reckless Bushwhacker. The deck also includes cards like Experimental Synthesizer and Gleeful Demolition for card advantage and removal. The mana base is built to support the aggressive strategy with a mix of lands that provide both red and green mana sources to cast spells efficiently.

The deck focuses on utilizing cheap and aggressive creatures along with burn spells to quickly pressure the opponent. It also includes cards like Showdown of the Skalds to generate card advantage and Reckless Impulse to dig deeper into the deck. The inclusion of Jegantha, the Wellspring as a companion provides additional flexibility and mana fixing. Overall, the main strategy is to constantly apply pressure on the opponent's life total while maintaining card advantage and board presence.

The focus of this deck is to quickly apply pressure on the opponent through sacrificing creatures and dealing damage. By combining cards like Mayhem Devil, Cauldron Familiar, and Witch's Oven, this deck aims to create a strong board presence while disrupting the opponent's strategy. Utilizing cards like Thoughtseize and Fatal Push helps to control the opponent's plays, while cards like Claim the Firstborn and Deadly Dispute provide additional ways to generate value through sacrificing creatures. Overall, this deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with aggression and synergy within the Rakdos Sacrifice archetype.

Utilizing a combination of removal spells, hand disruption, and graveyard recursion, the Dimir Control deck aims to control the game by disrupting the opponent's game plan and out-valuing them in the long run. The deck focuses on efficiently removing threats, disrupting the opponent's hand with cards like Thoughtseize, and utilizing graveyard recursion with cards like Sheoldred, the Apocalypse. The deck aims to generate card advantage and control the game through a combination of removal and disruption, ultimately grinding the opponent out of resources and winning through incremental advantage.

The deck focuses on quickly generating card advantage through casting spells like Opt and Treasure Cruise to fuel the graveyard for the frequent reanimation of Arclight Phoenix. It also utilizes cheap removal spells like Lightning Axe and Fiery Impulse to control the board while using Thing in the Ice as a potential win condition. The deck aims to be proactive and aggressive, aiming to overwhelm opponents with a flurry of spells and creatures to close out the game quickly.

The main concept of this deck is to create a fast and aggressive gameplay based on green devotion. By utilizing mana dorks such as Llanowar Elves and Elvish Mystic, along with cards like Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx and Wolfwillow Haven, the deck aims to ramp up quickly and play powerful creatures like Cavalier of Thorns and Old-Growth Troll. The inclusion of cards like Karn, the Great Creator and Storm the Festival provide additional value and card advantage. Overall, the deck focuses on overwhelming the opponent with a strong board presence and efficient mana usage.
